preconditions: Core cache store uses explicit byte, entry, TTL, shard and coalescing bounds.
Warm-up runner receives only explicit inline keys and verified Core sources.
scenarios.input: Strict warm-up with one required file key and authorization, metadata and byte targets enabled.
scenarios.action: Run the bounded pipeline, read cached authorization and bytes, inspect cache metrics.
scenarios.expected_result: Readiness is reached; all Core targets are populated; cache hit metrics and warm-up counters/histogram are emitted.
scenarios.expected_state: No authorizer call is repeated on a fresh cache hit after warm-up.

preconditions: Required and optional warm-up keys are distinguished explicitly.
Authoritative source can return a permanent error.
scenarios.input: Required key fails; separately, an optional key fails.
scenarios.action: Run strict warm-up for both configurations and inspect readiness and warm-up metrics.
scenarios.expected_result: Required failure blocks readiness with an error; optional failure keeps readiness and increments result=FAILED for tier OPTIONAL.
scenarios.expected_state: Failure attribution uses only cache and tier labels.

preconditions: Every timeout, concurrency, retry and cache bound is supplied explicitly.
More keys than max_keys are configured.
scenarios.input: Omit or invalidate each bound; run a six-key configuration with max_keys=3; force a per-key timeout and transient/permanent source errors.
scenarios.action: Validate configuration, run the pipeline, measure maximum authorizer concurrency and retry counts.
scenarios.expected_result: Invalid config is rejected before start; keys are deterministically trimmed; concurrency never exceeds 2; timeouts are enforced; only transient errors retry.
scenarios.expected_state: No hidden defaults substitute missing values.

preconditions: Access epoch and file revision are exposed by the internal Core epoch source.
PostgreSQL mutations bump access_epoch and notify invalidation in one transaction.
scenarios.input: A warmed authorization is followed by an epoch bump, revoked grant, and an epoch-source outage.
scenarios.action: Attempt repeated authorized reads and statically verify access-epoch mutation order in Core adapters and migration.
scenarios.expected_result: Stale authorization is never reused; a fresh authoritative check occurs; an unavailable epoch source fails closed.
scenarios.expected_state: Public credential-bound session contract is unchanged.

preconditions: Warmed byte, metadata and authorization entries exist for one file.
Targeted notification and reconnect paths are available.
scenarios.input: Targeted invalidation, revision change, and reconnect after a missed notification.
scenarios.action: Invalidate through Store.Notify/NotifyBatch and Store.OnReconnect, then read bytes and metadata.
scenarios.expected_result: Targeted invalidation removes exact keys; revision mismatch prevents stale bytes; reconnect clears all caches.
scenarios.expected_state: Invalidation emits bounded, low-cardinality cache metrics.

preconditions: Observer captures the local Prometheus-compatible metric snapshot.
Cache and warm-up operations have run.
scenarios.input: GET /metrics from the observer after warm-up and invalidation.
scenarios.action: Verify required cache metric families and audit every cache label set.
scenarios.expected_result: All cache metric families are present; labels stay in the allowed low-cardinality vocabulary; no file ID, principal ID, URL, query or locale is exposed.
scenarios.expected_state: Metrics endpoint remains no-store via the shared observer handler.

preconditions: Refresh interval, total timeout, per-key timeout and max_keys are explicit.
Authorization entries expire between cycles so repeated work is observable.
scenarios.input: Run an initial cycle, then a 120 ms refresh loop over three keys with concurrency=1.
scenarios.action: Count authoritative calls and maximum in-flight work; inspect cache inventory.
scenarios.expected_result: Cycles repeat without overlap, cache entries do not grow beyond max_keys, and context cancellation ends the loop cleanly.
scenarios.expected_state: Warm-up metrics accumulate across cycles without duplicate counters.

preconditions: Coalescing is enabled with explicit max_waiters and timeout.
One cold authorization key is requested concurrently.
scenarios.input: Eight concurrent authorization misses; separately, a leader whose source returns an error.
scenarios.action: Hold the leader until waiters join, release it, and inspect results and coalescing metrics.
scenarios.expected_result: One leader load serves all waiters; each waiter is counted once; a leader error is shared and no stale value is cached.
scenarios.expected_state: Coalescing counters are published exactly once through a monotonic cursor.

preconditions: A byte-cache entry has been warmed through the verified metadata path.
View.Intact exists to detect illegal buffer mutation.
scenarios.input: Two consecutive cache hits, followed by an intentional mutation of the exposed byte slice.
scenarios.action: Compare buffer identity and check Intact before and after mutation; run the scenario with -race.
scenarios.expected_result: A hit returns the same buffer without allocating a copy; mutation is detected by the integrity digest.
scenarios.expected_state: Public HTTP/cache contract is unchanged; no mutation guard is disabled.

preconditions: Invalidation batch size and window are explicit.
Warmed byte, metadata and authorization entries exist.
scenarios.input: A notification batch within the size bound and a batch exceeding the bound.
scenarios.action: Apply both batches through Store.NotifyBatch and inspect inventory and batch metrics.
scenarios.expected_result: Within-bound notifications invalidate exact keys; overflow clears every cache and increments result=OVERFLOW.
scenarios.expected_state: No stale entry survives overflow; reconnect and targeted paths remain distinct.
